story_title: OpenAI Reveals Early Scientific Experiments Powered by GPT-5
caption:
OpenAI has published early research cases detailing how GPT-5 accelerates scientific discovery across math, physics, biology, and computer science.

Rather than acting purely as a writing or coding assistant, researchers are using the model to generate proofs and uncover hidden theoretical patterns.

What scientific field do you think will be transformed fastest by AI?
